# Offline piano reference recordings

`C4v16.flac`, `D#4v16.flac`, `F#4v16.flac`, `A4v16.flac`, `C5v16.flac`, and `D#5v16.flac` are Alexander Holm's Salamander Grand Piano V3 samples, obtained from the [sfzinstruments SalamanderGrandPiano repository](https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano/tree/master/Samples). Their license is in `LICENSE` (CC BY 3.0).

These files are used only on the computer to analyze a few spectral ratios and to render a reference WAV. They are not listed in the active Gowin project and are not packed into the FPGA bitstream.

2026-10-05: added `C3v16.flac` from the same repository and license for independent low-C3 scalar-mode fitting. Original asset URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano/master/Samples/C3v16.flac . It is PC-only; the isolated C3 diagnostic contains fitted scalar coefficients, not recorded PCM.
